run_libsize_check: run libsize.py to check the file size of a compiled .so library file
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare a .so file size against a previously saved baseline
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py to save a .so file size baseline for future comparison runs
review_libsize_script: review the libsize.py script that reports .so file size changes between builds
refactor_libsize_script: refactor the libsize.py script to use argparse instead of raw sys.argv parsing
